About Us

Welcome to CookSmart

CookSmart Premium Food started its journey in 2015 in the food processing sector, under the able guidance and leadership of Mr Santanu Saha. Since then there has been no looking back — our current turnover touches around ₹90 crore, with our own production.

Our endless journey towards ultimate quality and excellence, for better consumer satisfaction, inspires us to keep improving on our present best.

Read Our Story

Our Heritage

Decades ago, spices were ground by hand at home.

Housewives made their own blends on the grinding stone. With changing times, that is giving way to ready-to-use spices in convenient packs — and the care behind them matters as much as ever.
